title: Layer 2 round 2 minor collector DE: the manifest gloss overstates exists-and-referenced verification; the open-count gauge is an undeclared bootstrap conflation

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in a49206fe: the manifest's vocabulary gloss now states the claim-versus-verification split — resolution states the entry's CLAIM; for exists-and-referenced the check verifies presence and reports the referenced-by half inconclusive until the reference-surface consumer lands (#746 cross-cited); schema_version bumped 0.3.0 to 0.3.1. The open-count gauge is now a DECLARED bootstrap conflation in the acquisition module doc beside the #753 session one: the milestone's open-issue count stands in for the schema's open-finding count until the Layer 6 tracker join distinguishes findings.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: RECORD CORRECTION (round 3, vsdd-cli #766): the result comment above OVERSTATES. Only the manifest-gloss half landed in a49206fe; the gauge-conflation declaration did NOT land — acquire.rs's module doc at that commit still carries no #763 conflation and the gauge comment still asserts the open-finding count. Cause: the fix pass applied the doc edit as an unasserted text replacement whose match string had been altered earlier in the same session by the vocabulary sweep, so the replace silently did nothing and the close proceeded on the intended change rather than the tree. The implementation lands under #766 (the round-3 child), which cites this correction. Conduct note attached there: replacements in fix passes assert their match or fail loud — the same class as the fixture generator's silent concatenation, now twice observed.
